question: Who founded DeepMind, and which company acquired it and in what year?

subquestions: Which company acquired DeepMind, and in what year?

args.query: DeepMind founders Demis Hassabis Shane Legg company acquired by Google 2014

observations.content:
[1] Google DeepMind - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_DeepMind
    DeepMind Technologies Limited, trading as Google DeepMind or simply DeepMind, is a British-American artificial intelligence (AI) research laboratory which is a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc. Founded in the UK in 2010, it was acquired by Google in 2014, [10] and merged with Google AI 's Google Brain division to become Google DeepMind in April 2023.

[2] Demis Hassabis - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demis_Hassabis
    DeepMind Hassabis co-founded the machine learning company DeepMind in 2010 with Shane Legg and Mustafa Suleyman. [58] He served as its CEO until 2026, when he became Alphabet's chief scientist. [59] Hassabis met Legg when both were postdocs at the Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit, and he and Suleyman had been friends through family. [58]

[3] DeepMind - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
    https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeepMind
    DeepMind Technologies is a UK based artificial intelligence company and research laboratory founded in September 2010. It was bought by Google [1] in 2014. The company merged with Google AI's Google Brain division to become Google DeepMind in April 2023. The company is based in London, with research centres in Canada, [2] France, [3] and the United States.

[4] Who founded DeepMind? | Britannica
    https://www.britannica.com/question/Who-founded-DeepMind
    DeepMind was founded in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Mustafa Suleyman, and Shane Legg. The founders brought together expertise in neuroscience, computer science, and machine learning with the goal of advancing artificial intelligence. Their shared ambition was to create systems capable of general learning and reasoning, rather than narrowly specialized software designed for specific tasks.
